name: リンクと切替が混在する設定セクション
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0003 リンクと切替が混在する設定セクション.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact mixed-link-and-toggle settings section. Use the original second group, normalized x16,y298,w358,h205 (pixel crop48,901,1082,620), including its section heading. Japanese text verbatim: 作成と操作 above the group, then four rows 休止中の自動応答 / 署名の設定 / 返信の候補 / 入力をサポート. Preserve Meiryo Regular, heading logical12px/16px, row labels14px/24px, tracking0. Source original icon geometry takes precedence: row1 small upright suitcase outline with top handle and inner horizontal band (NOT the mock's document); row2 diagonal pen nib with source's fine parallel pen details (NOT a generic oversized pencil); row3 bent leftward reply arrow (NOT the mock speech bubble); row4 diagonal pencil outline. Keep all source glyphs equal optical size/weight, now white inside small matching slate #526173 rounded square tiles. First three rows have small light-neutral source chevrons at right. Fourth row has an ON switch, thumb on RIGHT, forest-green gradient track and white circular thumb; preserve correct native switch proportions, no checkmark or textual ON. Thin neutral inset separators start at label column. White rounded group, heading aligned with left edge, pure-white outer canvas, compact approximately358px logical width, four44–48px rows, scale uniformly into a readable landscape image around1536x1024 with restrained margins. No extra heading, phone, controls or content.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Retain enabled-state distinction with forest-green ON track and right white thumb. Omit the orange/teal split because no separate group boundary or label makes it necessary here; use consistent slate supporting-icon tiles, preserving source glyphs. No decorative per-icon colors.
reviewNotes: 原版・対象crop・モックを目視。モックの書類/吹き出しを採用せず原版の鞄/返信矢印とペン細部を優先。橙/青緑の装飾的分割は省略し、補助アイコンを共通slateへ、青いON表示は森緑へ適応。生成後に日本語見出しと4項目、3シェブロン、右つまみON、アイコン、整列と白面を目視確認。厳密なフォント/ピクセル一致、操作/native編集/所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
